baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمَ ... لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The encounter-day supplies the vantage point while residence is measured against either of two bounded day-parts, compressing an unspecified stay without assigning it a computed chronology.

activation_trace.role: A day as an unspecified duration supplies the retrospective scale.
Residence or staying is the span compressed by the simile.
Evening supplies one bounded edge of a day.
Forenoon supplies the alternative bounded daytime measure.

changed_reading.before: They remained only a short time.
changed_reading.after: From encounter, their whole residence feels no longer than one evening or that day's forenoon; the alternatives mark scale rather than a computed total.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact ضُحَاهَا echo links the final forenoon to the earlier darkening of night and bringing out of forenoon; the whole residence is miniaturized within a governed light-cycle.

activation_trace.role: Darkening night makes the dark phase an operation, not a neutral clock label.
Night and darkness establish one pole of the cycle.
Bringing from concealment makes daylight's appearance an operation.
The exact focus-word echo contributes forenoon brightness as the revealed pole.
The focus forenoon receives the earlier created-cycle resonance.

structural_cues: 79:29 and 79:46 repeat ضُحَاهَا with the same suffix; the former coordinates darkening night and bringing out forenoon, while the latter coordinates evening or its forenoon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact echo and darkening/bringing-out sequence; I infer that the final scale evokes an operated cycle. The live alternative is ordinary reuse of time-of-day language.

changed_reading.before: Evening and forenoon are generic short units.
changed_reading.after: They are edges of a created light-cycle, and the entire residence is reduced to one phase whose darkness and brightness are brought about.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembered striving precedes uncovered consequence and preference for worldly life; when the focus repeats seeing and compresses the stay, shortness revalues intact memory rather than resulting from amnesia.

activation_trace.role: Retrieval after or with forgetting supplies explicit recovery of what was done.
Uncovering makes consequence manifest before the estimate.
Direct sight links exposed consequence to the focus act of seeing.
Preference by choice makes worldly life an invested object, not mere elapsed time.
The worldly or lower designation marks the chosen life's relative rank.
Repeated sight supplies the final vantage for re-scaling remembered life.
The former residence contracts despite the retained record.

structural_cues: 79:35 makes recollection precede 79:36 exposure; 79:38 names the chosen object as worldly life before 79:46 repeats seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered striving, exposed consequence, sight, and preference; I infer that memory survives while encounter changes valuation and scale. Alternatively, these scenes may be independent and shortness merely retrospective.

changed_reading.before: The stay seems short because the past has become vague or forgotten.
changed_reading.after: They remember what they did, yet the chosen worldly residence contracts once consequence is uncovered; shortness is a verdict of exposure, not amnesia.

context_deltas.mechanism: The request to moor the Hour is redirected from human chronology to its Lord-held endpoint and warning; the focus then gives experiential certainty at seeing, where prior time loses scale.

activation_trace.role: Questioning initiates the demand for temporal placement.
Anchorage frames the demand as fixing the Hour in chronology.
Reminder language makes the event present without dating it.
An endpoint relocates final determination to the Lord.
Warning supplies the practical response in place of a date.
Seeing replaces speculative placement with direct certainty.

structural_cues: The sequence asks أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا, redirects مُنتَهَاهَا to the Lord, limits the messenger to warning, then shifts to يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies request, anchorage, endpoint, warning, and sight; I infer redirection from calendar knowledge to encounter-knowledge. Alternatively, withheld dating and the short-stay simile may be adjacent but independent.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply states how brief life will seem.
changed_reading.after: It answers the demand to moor the Hour on a human timeline: its date is withheld, but seeing it collapses prior time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it carries a peripheral rushing-motion branch of ن ز ع into the opening without identifying its agents; valid as a formal contrast between advance and the focus root's stopping. Render only as kinetic resonance, not translation or referent assignment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا against the opening sequence's motion forms

activation_trace.role: A rushing-travel branch supplies an exploratory initial impulse.
Repeated advance and racing make forward motion explicit.
Stopping and slowness anchor the outlier in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The last line's short stay is isolated from the opening.
changed_reading.after: The opening rush can resonate at closure as an anti-lingering arc: movement outruns stopping until residence seems negligible.

strongest_changes: Remembered striving still contracts, making shortness a re-scaling of intact memory.
The exact ضُحَاهَا echo binds the estimate to the operated dark-light cycle of 79:29.
The mooring-and-endpoint sequence makes 79:46 an experiential answer to the demand for a date.
summary.what_was_special: Created-cycle scaling, evaluative exposure, and rhetorical redirection remain distinct coexisting mechanisms without selecting one chronology.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus pronoun's antecedent and the precise stay measured are not fixed by the inventories alone.
The kinetic activation uses non-primary branch reach and should retain its stated containment.
